purpose: 6h: one launch. rt_hair_header_scene_pass (the strand header applied only at the scene G-buffer pass, never at the decal pass) toggled inside the run under hl1's wheel dolly in and out. With the key and without the card fill: no label taken by the decal pass and strands in every frame (frame watchdog trips 0, no frame on cards, no draw under a tenth of its card pixels). With the key and the fill: the same, then the still image (PNG) and hc1's slow orbit. Last without the key: the header pass line shows the labels the decal pass took (the cause of hx1 180928's loss).
